chapter: Brass bands, Buddy Petit and horns
title: A job at Cantillie and the replacement cornet players
summary: A Saturday hall job with Tom Abbott on violin, finding a cornet player, and the player quitting; Buddy wants back in.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Once, I had a job, we had a job back at Cantillie.
